Test 19
For each question, choose the correct answer.
River Cleaning Event
Report by Lily Hahn
I recently took part in an event called River Clean, where volunteers collect rubbish from a river. I'd wanted to do one ever since I saw an online post from a school friend, describing one she'd done. Then one day, down near the river, there was a poster on the noticeboard providing details about a River Clean event. It included the phone number of the person starting it up so you could register your name. And that's what I did!
On the day, I went to the river and was given some plastic bags and thick gloves. Everyone looked friendly. Most had brought thick gloves, which the organisers had asked us to do if possible. I was pleased there were spare ones to borrow, as I'd forgotten mine. We read through a list of instructions, and after being given the chance to ask questions, we started cleaning.
I'm generally a sociable person, but once I started, I mostly worked in silence, probably because I had to focus so much. When we'd finished, despite there being only a small number of us, we'd collected a lot of rubbish. Unfortunately, I think it will keep piling up in the river unless people change their habits. But seeing everything we'd removed in one place felt like an achievement and clearly showed the problem. I never imagined there'd be so much rubbish in and around the river. The most common sort was plastic packets.
We finished exactly at midday, and once we'd gone, we completed a short questionnaire about our opinions on solving the problem of rubbish in rivers. Everyone had useful ideas, like providing more bins or organising more river clean events. I think people need to be taught to use bins! There's lots of information about recycling in schools, but in people's homes, so much plastic gets thrown away. And I think unless people start buying products that aren't wrapped in plastic, nothing we do will have an effect, even if we did a river clean weekly! So that's what I put.

questions.text: How did Lily find out that the event was happening?

options.label: A
options.text: from talking to someone she knew at school

options.label: B
options.text: from speaking to the organisers

options.label: C
options.text: from some information by the river

options.label: D
options.text: from an advertisement on social media

questions.explanation: 解析：Lily 发现活动的方式是 “there was a poster on the noticeboard providing details about a River Clean event”（河边布告栏的海报），对应 C 选项 “河边的信息”。

questions.text: When she arrived at the river, Lily

options.label: A
options.text: recognised some of the other volunteers.

options.label: B
options.text: found she'd forgotten some important equipment.

options.label: C
options.text: listened to a talk about what she had to do.

options.label: D
options.text: discovered the event had started without her.

questions.explanation: 解析：Lily 到达河边时，“I'd forgotten mine [gloves], but there were spare ones to borrow”（忘记带手套），对应 B 选项 “发现忘记重要装备”。

questions.text: How did Lily feel after the River Clean event?

options.label: A
options.text: surprised by the amount of rubbish she found

options.label: B
options.text: upset that there was still rubbish in the river

options.label: C
options.text: amazed by the wide variety of rubbish she collected

options.label: D
options.text: disappointed that so few people helped clean up the rubbish

questions.explanation: 解析：活动后 Lily“never imagined there'd be so much rubbish in and around the river”（惊讶于垃圾数量），对应 A 选项 “惊讶于发现的垃圾数量”。

questions.text: Lily says the most important thing people can do is to

options.label: A
options.text: teach their children to respect the environment.

options.label: B
options.text: take part in river clean events regularly.

options.label: C
options.text: use the bins at the river.

options.label: D
options.text: change their shopping habits.

questions.explanation: 解析：Lily 认为最重要的是 “unless people start buying products that aren't wrapped in plastic, nothing we do will have an effect”（改变购物习惯），对应 D 选项 “改变购物习惯”。

questions.text: What would Lily write in a text to her friend?

options.label: A
options.text: I didn't like having to spend my time picking up other people's rubbish and I think I wasted my time

options.label: B
options.text: I'm so glad I got to take part. It's not something I'd ever heard of before, and I think it's a great idea.

options.label: C
options.text: Everyone was just concentrating on their section of the river, so we didn't spend a lot of time chatting. Quite unusual for me!

options.label: D
options.text: The organisers are sending us a link for a form where we can suggest solutions to the problem. I think that's a good idea.

questions.explanation: 解析：C 选项 “每个人都只专注于自己的河段，所以我们没花太多时间聊天。对我来说很不寻常！” 与原文 “generally a sociable person, but mostly worked in silence” 一致。
